scholarship_title: DAAD EPOS Scholarship: MSc Development Economics, University of Göttingen (intake 2027/2028)
provider_organization: German Academic Exchange Service (DAAD), with the University of Göttingen
eligible_nationalities: Other developing countries on DAAD's EPOS (OECD-DAC) country list

financial_coverage.tuition_coverage: No tuition fees for EPOS scholarship holders; registration or enrolment fees may still apply

stipend.notes: EUR 992 a month for graduates for the length of the 24-month programme

additional_benefits: Health, accident and personal liability insurance contributions
Travel allowance (unless paid by the home country or another funder)
Rent subsidy and family allowance in some cases

application_fee.notes: Not stated on the Göttingen EPOS page or DAAD's EPOS entry.

language_proficiency: IELTS or TOEFL at the level set by the programme (institutional TOEFL not accepted)
eligibility_criteria.age_limit: None, but your latest degree should normally be no more than six years old
eligibility_criteria.work_experience_years: 2 (relevant work after the bachelor's degree, at the time of application)

required_documents.name: CV
required_documents.detail: Reverse chronological, no unexplained gaps, Europass format preferred

required_documents.name: Letter of motivation
required_documents.detail: One identical letter for all courses you apply to (max 3), explaining your choice and priority

required_documents.name: Recommendation letter from current employer
required_documents.detail: Official letterhead, signed, stamped and recently dated

required_documents.name: Certificates of employment
required_documents.detail: Showing at least two years of relevant work after the bachelor's; ideally with a re-employment guarantee

required_documents.name: Degree certificates
required_documents.detail: Certified translation if not in English or German

required_documents.name: Full transcript of records
required_documents.detail: With an explanation of the grading system if not on the transcript

preparation_alerts: Get an employer recommendation and employment certificates showing two years' work after your bachelor's
Book IELTS or TOEFL early; institutional TOEFL is not accepted
Apply on Göttingen's portal and choose 'Development Economics with DAAD EPOS SCHOLARSHIP'; one application covers admission and funding

criteria.criterion: Review of application by the course selection committee

selection_criteria.pass_rule: The course nominates candidates; DAAD then asks nominees to upload the full application to the DAAD portal. Decisions by email in mid-March.

verification_status.verification_notes: Göttingen says applications are only possible 1 Oct to 15 Nov each year, so the intake 2027 window is open now; its linked guide is still labelled 2026, so a human should confirm no date change. Nigeria is on DAAD's EPOS country list (dac_laenderliste_epos.pdf), but that PDF is marked 'validity 2024-2025'; no newer list was found. Göttingen's own programme entry requirements (grades) were not read. Stipend is DAAD's current graduate rate.
